काठमांडू, 10 अगस्त : नेपाल ओलम्पिक समितिक अध्यक्ष जीवन राम श्रेष्ठ नेपाली खेल मे जे प्रगति आ सफलता भेटबाक चाही छल ताहि मे अस्थिरता बाधित भेल बतौलनि ।

रविदिन नेपाल स्की संघके सातम वार्षिक आम सभामे बजैत राष्ट्रपति श्रेष्ठ जौं सब कियो कानूनी ढांचामे ईमानदारीसँ काज करए तऽ खेलमे अस्थिरता दूर कएल जा सकैत अछि, जाहिसँ संघ सभ आत्मविश्वाससँ खेलक विकासमे आगू बढि सकैत अछि ।

ओ आशा व्यक्त केलथि जे देश मे हाल मे आयल बदलाव स खेल क्षेत्र मे सकारात्मक परिवर्तन आओत। हुनी कहलकै, 'अनिश्चितता, अस्थिरता, आरू हस्तक्षेप के समाप्त करला स॑ खेल विकास के रास्ता खुलतै आरू राष्ट्रीय गौरव बढ़तै ।

स्की एसोसिएशन के अध्यक्ष सेहो रहल श्रेष्ठ नेपाल मे स्कीइंग के विकास मे अपन पूरा प्रयास लगा रहल बतौलनि ।

हुनी नोट करलकै कि भले ही सब इरादा के लक्ष्य पूरा नै होय सकलौ छै, लेकिन हर संभव प्रयास करलौ जाय रहलौ छै । ओ कहलनि जे, नेपाल मे विश्व के सबस ऊँच पहाड़ माउंट सागरमाथा सहित हिमालय के घर रहला के बावजूद शीतकालीन खेल के नाम राष्ट्र मे बहुत कम अछि। श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, जौं स्कीइंग के विकास भ सकैत अछि त नेपाल स्की पर्यटन के गंतव्य बनि सकैत अछि।

उपराष्ट्रपति रामा भट्टराई खेलके प्रचार प्रसार मे सहयोग देनिहार सब गोटेके धन्यवाद देलखिन । महासचिव विजया श्रेष्ठ नेपाल मे स्कीइंग के चुनौती के स्वीकार केलनि मुदा संघ एहि खेल के यथासंभव बढ़ावा देबय लेल काज क रहल अछि से पुष्टि केलनि।

उद्घाटन समारोहमे नेपाल रग्बी संघके अध्यक्ष दीपक देवकोटा; नेपाल हैण्डबॉल संघके अध्यक्ष पीताम्बर तिमिलसिना डा. चतुरानन राजवैद्य, एनओसी के उपाध्यक्ष, प्रो. राजीव श्रेष्ठ, एनओसी के महासचिव, प्रो. एवं राष्ट्रीय खेल परिषद के प्रतिनिधि धन शाही।

ई आयोजन के दौरान एसोसिएशन न॑ स्नोलाइन नाम केरऽ पत्रिका के अनावरण भी करलकै, जेकरा म॑ स्की गतिविधि आरू लेख शामिल छै ।

एसोसिएशन के बंद सत्र में 1000 रुपया के वार्षिक बजट के समर्थन कायल गेल। वित्तीय वर्ष 2083-84 के लिये 34,808,800 रुपये। ई बजट राष्ट्रीय प्रतियोगिता के आयोजन, अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आयोजनऽ म॑ भाग लेबै, प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम के संचालन, आरू शीतकालीन ओलंपिक के तैयारी लेली आवंटित करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

सत्रमे उपाध्यक्ष राम भट्टराई द्वारा प्रस्तुत कार्ययोजना, महासचिव विजय श्रेष्ठ द्वारा प्रस्तुत वार्षिक प्रतिवेदन, आ कोषाध्यक्ष जितेन्द्र श्रेष्ठ द्वारा प्रस्तुत वित्तीय प्रतिवेदनके अनुमोदन सेहो कएल गेल अछि ।

स्की एसोसिएशन केरऽ अधिकारी आरू सदस्य न॑ ई सभा म॑ शारीरिक आरू वर्चुअल दोनों तरह स॑ भाग लेलकै । एसोसिएशन केरऽ नया विधान म॑ व्यक्तिगत रूप स॑ उपस्थित नै होय वाला सदस्यऽ क॑ वर्चुअल रूप स॑ विधानसभा म॑ शामिल होय के अनुमति देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

title: Opinion | Nepal needs to rethink its antimicrobial resistance strategy - The Kathmandu Post
description: Opinion | Nepal needs to rethink its antimicrobial resistance strategy  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Many people have heard about antibiotics, but do not precisely know what this medicine is and how it works, let alone what antimicrobial resistance (AMR) means. Yet, many have wondered why some infections become difficult to treat, even when antimicrobials are available. Do antimicrobials always work against infections? The fact remains that infectious agents, such as bacteria, do spontaneously develop resistance over time. But this process can be accelerated when bacteria are repeatedly exposed to antimicrobials, including through unnecessary or inappropriate use.

For the past several years, studies have consistently shown that Nepal, like other South Asian countries, experiences excessive and inappropriate use of antimicrobials. In urban areas, one can easily walk into a drug shop, explain symptoms and buy antibiotics, often without a prescription. A patient with a common cold may demand antibiotics even though antibiotics do not work against viruses.

But this is only one side of Nepal’s story. Travel to remote areas, and the problem may be the opposite. For populations in far-flung villages, access to even basic and essential antimicrobials can be difficult. A bacterial infection that could have been treated relatively easily could become severe and complicated. By the time the patient reaches a hospital, treatment can be more complicated and much more expensive.

This is the tension between access and excess. In one place, antimicrobials are easily available and consumed unnecessarily; in another, people who genuinely need them struggle to obtain them. Here lies the unsettling heterogeneity of who becomes vulnerable and who does not, and who needs attention and who, relatively, does not. This is the first premise where community engagement can offer solutions.

Such contradictions in Nepal’s supply side and demand side cannot simply be fixed by bombarding people with recommendations about ‘appropriate antibiotic use’. In such scenarios, stakeholder analysis allows one to explore a multitude of interests and their interactions, understand why people behave as they do, and analyse how health systems, pharmacies, patients, farmers and communities function within their own circumstances and in relation to each other. This is the second premise where community engagement can help resolve the puzzle.

Yet, engagement strategies have sometimes been given unequal weight, particularly with a preference for participatory and dialogue-based activities over approaches that prioritise breadth of engagement. In practice, however, both approaches can and need to coexist, often complementing each other.

Historically, experts developed recommendations at the centre, bureaucracies converted them into programmes, and instructions travelled downward through the health system until they eventually reached communities. Nepal is familiar with this model where a guideline is prepared in Kathmandu, training is provided at the provincial or district level, posters reach health facilities, and communities are told what behaviour should change. Inadequate community buy-in as such can undermine the entire effort.

The one-way nature of vertical engagement has also been rightly criticised. Experts and bureaucrats may prescribe solutions for communities whose everyday experiences are radically different from their own. Recommendations can be technically sound and well-intentioned but also poorly grounded and unrealistic. Imagine telling a person in a remote village that antibiotics must only be taken after consulting a qualified doctor when reaching that doctor requires a day’s walk and considerable expense. Or telling a small poultry farmer to simply reduce antimicrobial use without discussing veterinary access, disease prevention and the possibility that losing chickens may mean losing the household’s income.

Participatory engagement has enormous value. Community members can be involved from the outset, contribute to identifying problems, setting agendas, designing interventions, implementing activities, and evaluating results. Such involvement can garner trust, ownership and produce interventions grounded in local realities. Patients may explain why they avoid health facilities. Farmers may describe why antimicrobials are important for protecting their livestock. These conversations can reveal problems that an expert sitting in Kathmandu may never see.

But enthusiasm for deep participation should not lead us to undervalue another dimension of engagement—breadth. Nepal’s experience with vaccination, mass drug administration and public health campaigns demonstrates the value of reaching hundreds of thousands, sometimes millions, of people. Radio, television, schools, social media, health facilities and community networks can carry simple messages about antibiotics across enormous populations.

Such breadth-based engagement may lack the depth of a small participatory meeting, but its scale is precisely the strength. A community dialogue involving 30 people can uncover why antibiotics are misused in one municipality. A nationwide radio campaign can make hundreds of thousands think twice before demanding antibiotics for a viral cold. Why must one be considered inherently superior to the other?

This is precisely where diagonal community engagement becomes useful. It combines vertical, population-wide strategies with bottom-up, participatory and dialogue-based engagement. This is particularly relevant for Nepal as it is efficient for low- and middle-income countries. AMR is a super-wicked problem. It involves human health, animal health, agriculture, food systems, pharmacies, hospitals, sanitation, environmental contamination, regulation, economics and human behaviour. There will never be one community, one message or one intervention capable of addressing all these dimensions.

Nepal therefore needs engagement that can travel in both directions. Scientific evidence, surveillance, regulation and national communication must move outward from institutions to communities. At the same time, experiences, constraints and solutions emerging from communities must travel back towards policymakers and researchers. Health governance, in other words, should re-orient the approach to reap benefits from a combination of conventional vertical and more recent participatory approaches.

For AMR control, while relevant to many other public health interventions, the idea is to blend these approaches to reach millions at scale and listen deeply to socio-cultural features while identifying and safeguarding vulnerabilities.

बहुत लोग एंटीबायोटिक दवाइयक कें बारे मे सुनने छै, मुदा इ ठीक सं पता नहि छै की इ दवाई की छै आ इ कोना काज करएयत छै, एंटीमाइक्रोबियल रेजिस्टेंस (AMR) कें मतलब त दूर कें बात छै. तइयो बहुतो कें ई सवाल उठल छै कि किछ संक्रमण कें इलाज मुश्किल कियैक भ जायत छै, भले ही रोगाणुरोधी दवाई उपलब्ध होय छै. की रोगाणुरोधी दवाइयक हमेशा संक्रमण कें खिलाफ काज करएयत छै? तथ्य इ छै कि संक्रामक एजेंट, जेना बैक्टीरिया, समय कें साथ अनायास प्रतिरोधक क्षमता जरूर पैदा करएयत छै. मुदा इ प्रक्रिया तखन तेज भ सकएय छै जखन बैक्टीरिया बेर-बेर रोगाणुरोधी दवाइयक कें संपर्क मे आएल होयत छै, जइ मे अनावश्यक या अनुचित उपयोग कें माध्यम सं सेहो शामिल छै.

पिछला कई साल स अध्ययन स लगातार पता चलल अछि जे नेपाल मे सेहो दक्षिण एशिया क अन्य देश क तरह रोगाणुरोधी दवाई क अत्यधिक आ अनुचित उपयोग होइत अछि । शहरी क्षेत्रक मे, कोनों व्यक्ति आसानी सं दवाक कें दोकान मे घुस सकएय छै, लक्षणक कें समझा सकएय छै आ एंटीबायोटिक दवाइयक खरीद सकएय छै, अक्सर बिना पर्चे कें. आम सर्दी कें रोगी एंटीबायोटिक दवाइयक कें मांग कयर सकएय छै, भले ही एंटीबायोटिक दवाइयक वायरस कें खिलाफ काज नहि करएयत छै.

मुदा ई नेपालक कथाक एकटा पक्ष मात्र अछि । सुदूर इलाका मे यात्रा करू, आ समस्या एकर उल्टा भ सकैत अछि। दूरस्थ गामक मे आबादी कें लेल बेसिक आ आवश्यक रोगाणुरोधी दवाइयक कें पहुंच सेहो मुश्किल भ सकएय छै. बैक्टीरिया कें संक्रमण जेकर इलाज अपेक्षाकृत आसानी सं कैल जा सकएय छै, गंभीर आ जटिल भ सकएय छै. जाबे तइक रोगी अस्पताल पहुंचएयत छै, ओकर इलाज बेसि जटिल भ सकएय छै आ बहुत बेसि महग भ सकएय छै.

ई पहुँच आ अतिरिक्त के बीच के तनाव छै. एक ठाम रोगाणुरोधी दवाई आसानी सं भेटैत अछि आ अनावश्यक सेवन भ जाइत अछि ; दोसर मे जिनका एकर सच्चा जरूरत छनि ओ लोक एकरा प्राप्त करबा लेल संघर्ष करैत छथि । एतय ई अशांत विषमता निहित अछि जे के कमजोर भ जाइत अछि आ के नहि, आ केकरा ध्यान देबय के जरूरत अछि आ केकरा, अपेक्षाकृत, नहिं. इ पहिल आधार छै जत समुदायक कें जुड़ाव समाधान पेश कयर सकय छै.

नेपाल केरऽ आपूर्ति पक्ष आरू मांग पक्ष म॑ ऐसनऽ विरोधाभास क॑ खाली ‘उचित एंटीबायोटिक उपयोग’ के बारे म॑ सिफारिशऽ स॑ लोगऽ प॑ बमबारी करी क॑ ठीक नै करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै । ऐहन परिदृश्यक मे हितधारक विश्लेषण कें अनुमति देयत छै की एकटा अनेक रुचि आ ओकर बातचीत कें खोज कैल जा सकय छै, इ समझल जा सकय छै की लोग ओय तरह कें व्यवहार कियाक करय छै, आ विश्लेषण करय सकय छै की स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली, दवाई कें दुकानक, मरीज, किसान आ समुदाय अपन परिस्थितिक कें भीतर आ एक दोसर कें संबंध मे कोना काज करय छै. इ दोसर आधार छै जतय सामुदायिक जुड़ाव पहेली कें हल करय मे मदद कयर सकय छै.

तइयो, संलग्नता रणनीतिक कें कखनो-कखनो असमान वजन देल गेल छै, विशेष रूप सं भागीदारी कें व्यापकता कें प्राथमिकता देवय वाला दृष्टिकोणक कें बजाय भागीदारी आ संवाद आधारित गतिविधियक कें प्राथमिकता देल गेल छै. मुदा व्यवहार मे दुनू दृष्टिकोण सह-अस्तित्व मे रहि सकैत अछि आ जरूरत अछि, जे प्रायः एक दोसराक पूरक होइत अछि ।

ऐतिहासिक रूप स॑ विशेषज्ञ न॑ केंद्र म॑ सिफारिश विकसित करलकै, नौकरशाही ओकरा कार्यक्रम म॑ बदली देलकै, आरू निर्देश स्वास्थ्य प्रणाली के माध्यम स॑ नीचें के तरफ यात्रा करलकै जब॑ तलक कि अंततः समुदाय तलक नै पहुँची गेलै । नेपाल एहि मॉडल स परिचित अछि जतय काठमांडू मे दिशा निर्देश तैयार कैल जाइत अछि, प्रांतीय या जिला स्तर पर प्रशिक्षण देल जाइत अछि, स्वास्थ्य सुविधा तक पोस्टर पहुंचैत अछि, आ समुदाय कए कहल जाइत अछि जे कोन व्यवहार मे बदलाव हेबाक चाही। अपर्याप्त सामुदायिक खरीद-इन जेना कि पूरा प्रयास कें कमजोर कयर सकय छै.

ऊर्ध्वाधर जुड़ाव के एकतरफा प्रकृति के भी सही आलोचना करलऽ गेलऽ छै । विशेषज्ञ आ नौकरशाह ओय समुदायक कें लेल समाधान निर्धारित कयर सकय छै, जेकर रोजमर्रा कें अनुभव ओकर अनुभव सं मौलिक रूप सं भिन्न छै. सिफारिश तकनीकी रूप सं सही आ नीक नीयत सं भ सकैत अछि मुदा खराब जमीनी आ अवास्तविक सेहो भ सकैत अछि. कल्पना करू जे कोनो सुदूर गाम मे कोनो व्यक्ति केँ ई कहब जे एंटीबायोटिक दवाई योग्य डॉक्टर सँ सलाह लेलाक बाद मात्र सेवन करय पड़त जखन ओहि डाक्टर लग पहुँचबा मे एक दिनक पैदल यात्रा आ काफी खर्चा करय पड़ैत छैक. या कोनों छोट मुर्गी पालन करय वाला कें कहनाय की पशु चिकित्सा पहुंच, बीमारी रोकथाम आ इ संभावना कें चर्चा करएय कें बिना बस रोगाणुरोधी दवाइयक कें उपयोग कें कम करएय कें लेल की मुर्गी कें नुकसान कें मतलब घरक कें आमदनी कें नुकसान भ सकएय छै.

सहभागी जुड़ाव के अपार मूल्य छै। समुदाय कें सदस्यक कें शुरु आत सं शामिल कैल जा सकएय छै, समस्याक कें पहचान करएय मे, एजेंडा तय करएय मे, हस्तक्षेपक कें डिजाइन करएय मे, गतिविधियक कें लागू करएय मे, आ परिणामक कें मूल्यांकन करएय मे योगदान द सकएय छै. ऐहन संलग्नता विश्वास, स्वामित्व जुटा सकय छै आ स्थानीय वास्तविकताक पर आधारित हस्तक्षेप पैदा कयर सकय छै. मरीज इ बता सकएय छै की ओ स्वास्थ्य सुविधाक सं बचएयत छै. किसानक इ वर्णन कयर सकय छै की ओकर पशुधन कें सुरक्षा कें लेल रोगाणुरोधी दवाइयक कें महत्व कियाक छै. एहि गप्प-सप्प स एहन समस्या सामने आबि सकैत अछि जे काठमांडू मे बैसल कोनो विशेषज्ञ कए शायद कहियो नहि देखबा मे आबि सकैत अछि।

मुदा गहींर सहभागिता के उत्साह हमरा सब के सगाई के एकटा आओर आयाम-व्यापकता के कम करय लेल नहिं ल' जेबाक चाही. नेपाल केरऽ टीकाकरण, सामूहिक औषधि प्रशासन आरू जनस्वास्थ्य अभियान केरऽ अनुभव लाखों, कखनी-कखनी लाखों लोगऽ तलक पहुँचै के मूल्य क॑ दर्शाबै छै । रेडियो, टेलीविजन, स्कूल, सोशल मीडिया, स्वास्थ्य सुविधाक आ सामुदायिक नेटवर्क विशाल आबादी मे एंटीबायोटिक दवाइयक कें बारे मे सरल संदेश पहुंचा सकय छै.

ऐन्हऽ व्यापकता आधारित जुड़ाव म॑ छोटऽ भागीदारी वाला बैठक के गहराई के कमी होय सकै छै, लेकिन एकरऽ पैमाना ठीक ताकत छै । 30 लोगक कें शामिल सामुदायिक संवाद सं पता चल सकय छै कि एकटा नगरपालिका मे एंटीबायोटिक कें दुरुपयोग कियाक कैल जायत छै. देशव्यापी रेडियो अभियान लाखों लोगऽ क॑ वायरल सर्दी लेली एंटीबायोटिक दवाई के मांग करै स॑ पहल॑ दू बार सोचै लेली मजबूर करी सकै छै । एकटा के दोसर स स्वाभाविक रूप स श्रेष्ठ किएक मानल जेबाक चाही?

ठीक यही ठाम तिरछा सामुदायिक जुड़ाव उपयोगी भ जायत छै. इ ऊर्ध्वाधर, जनसंख्या-व्यापी रणनीतियक कें साथ नीचा सं ऊपर, सहभागी आ संवाद आधारित जुड़ाव कें संयोजन करयत छै. ई नेपाल के लेलऽ विशेष रूप स॑ प्रासंगिक छै, कैन्हेंकि ई कम आरू मध्यम आय वाला देशऽ लेली कुशल छै । एएमआर एकटा सुपर-दुष्ट समस्या अछि। एहि मे मानव स्वास्थ्य, पशु स्वास्थ्य, कृषि, खाद्य प्रणाली, फार्मेसी, अस्पताल, स्वच्छता, पर्यावरण प्रदूषण, नियमन, अर्थशास्त्र आ मानव व्यवहार शामिल अछि । एहि सब आयाम कए संबोधित करबा मे सक्षम कहियो एकटा समुदाय, एकटा संदेश या एकटा हस्तक्षेप नहि होएत।

एहि लेल नेपाल के एहन सगाई के जरूरत अछि जे दुनू दिशा मे यात्रा क सकय. वैज्ञानिक साक्ष्य, निगरानी, ​​नियमन आ राष्ट्रीय संचार कें संस्थाक सं समुदायक मे बाहर दिस बढ़नाय आवश्यक छै. एकरऽ साथ ही समुदायऽ स॑ निकलै वाला अनुभव, बाधा आरू समाधान क॑ नीति निर्माता आरू शोधकर्ता के तरफ वापस जाय के जरूरत छै । स्वास्थ्य शासन कें, दोसर शब्दक मे, पारंपरिक ऊर्ध्वाधर आ बेसि हाल कें भागीदारी वाला दृष्टिकोण कें संयोजन सं लाभ उठावा कें लेल दृष्टिकोण कें पुनः उन्मुख करबाक चाही.

एएमआर नियंत्रण कें लेल, जखन कि बहुत सं अन्य जनस्वास्थ्य हस्तक्षेपक कें लेल प्रासंगिक छै, विचार इ छै की इ दृष्टिकोणक कें मिश्रण कैल जै ताकि पैमाना पर लाखक कें बीच पहुंचल जा सकय आ सामाजिक-सांस्कृतिक विशेषताक कें गहराई सं सुनल जा सकय आ जखन कि कमजोरी कें पहचान कैल जा सकय आ ओकर सुरक्षा कैल जा सकय.

full_article:
Jerusalem. The Israeli Foreign Ministry has welcomed a Nepali senior media delegation on a visit to Israel. The ministry's senior representative and head of the South Asia Department, Michael Weiler Tal, welcomed the Nepali team and discussed the historical relationship between Nepal and Israel.

She highlighted the historical and friendly relations between Nepal and Israel, various areas of cooperation between the two countries, and the importance of mutual relations, recalling that since the establishment of diplomatic relations in 1960, trust, cooperation, and people-to-people relations between the two countries have been strengthening.

She expressed confidence that this visit of Nepali media professionals will help them understand Israeli society, technology, innovation, security, agriculture, and various other aspects closely. A team of 18 Nepali journalists has been on a visit to Israel since Sunday.

title: Tracing three centuries of actuarial science from European roots to Nepal’s growing market - OnlineKhabar English News
description: Tracing three centuries of actuarial science from European roots to Nepal’s growing market  OnlineKhabar English News
publisher.title: OnlineKhabar English News
full_article:
Photo: University of Kent

While watching Gilmore Girls, I came across an interesting scene where Lorelai is introduced to an actuary by her mother. During the episode, the actuary discusses how he can predict the probability of death with great accuracy and mentions the use of actuarial models to do so. As a student of actuarial science, this scene really caught my attention. I was excited to see a television series from the 2000s that discussed actuaries, life tables, and their importance in insurance.

The history of actuarial science dates back to more than three centuries. Its origins lie in the growing interest in statistics and probability theory in the 17th century. At that time, governments and business people were interested in understanding population trends, mortality rates, and economic risk. But there existed no systematic way to measure how long people would live or how likely they were to die at a given age.

One of the earliest figures to address this problem was the English statistician John Graunt. In 1662, he studied the London “Bills of Mortality,” or records of births and deaths. Although his work may seem simple by modern standards, it was revolutionary for its time. For the first time, scholars attempted to quantitatively analyse patterns of human life and mortality using real data. Graunt’s research laid the foundation for demography, epidemiology, and ultimately actuarial science. A few decades later, the famous astronomer Edmond Halley (whom we know today best for Halley’s Comet) developed Graunt’s ideas further. In 1693, he studied the birth and death records of the city of Breslau (now Wrocław, Poland) and produced the first mortality table suitable for pricing life annuities

Halley’s contributions were not limited to collecting mortality data. He showed how to use mortality data to calculate the fair value of a life annuity. For the first time, insurance companies and financial institutions could mathematically determine how much money a person would have to pay based on their age and life expectancy. This is widely regarded as the birth of modern actuarial science. Mathematicians such as Blaise Pascal, Pierre de Fermat, and Jacob Bernoulli developed probability theory rapidly. Their work provided a mathematical basis for analysing uncertainty and transformed actuarial calculations from estimates to scientific and quantitative models.

By the 19th century, the actuarial profession had matured significantly for specialised professional bodies to emerge. The Institute of Actuaries was founded in London in 1848, and thereafter the Faculty of Actuaries was established in Scotland in 1856. These bodies formalised actuarial education, examination systems, and professional standards, and played a significant role in the development of the modern profession.

During the Industrial Revolution, the need for actuaries grew exponentially as life insurance expanded throughout Europe and North America. Actuaries became responsible for setting premiums, valuing reserves, analysing pension plans, and ensuring the financial stability of insurance companies. Their role thus expanded beyond calculating life expectancy.

Actuarial science experienced another major transformation in the 20th century. The field expanded from life insurance to health insurance, pensions, investments, banking, social security systems, and enterprise risk management. The development of computing technology made it possible to build advanced models for analysing big data and complex financial systems. In India, L. S. Vaidyanathan became the first Indian Fellow Actuary in 1926, a significant achievement for South Asia. In the following decades, actuarial education and professional institutions began to be established throughout Asia, Africa, and Latin America.

Today, actuaries work not only in insurance, but also in climate risk, healthcare financing, disaster modelling, investment management, artificial intelligence (AI), and public policy. Despite the great advances in technology, the core purpose of the profession remains the same as that envisioned by Halley in 1693: to use mathematics and statistics to understand uncertainty and help make informed decisions about the future.

Despite its long global history, actuarial science is a relatively new discipline in Nepal. Until the 2010s, Nepal had neither a formal actuarial education program nor a qualified actuary resident. In fact, formal actuarial education in Nepal only began in 2016 when the School of Mathematical Sciences of Tribhuvan University (SMSTU) launched the country’s first B.Math.Sc. (Actuarial Science) program.

Before that, Nepali insurance companies used to outsource all actuarial work to foreign consultants, and most students had never even heard of the actuarial profession. The SMSTU itself has noted that “there is a serious shortage of actuaries in the country due to a lack of actuarial education.”

A 2018 report found that there were no qualified actuaries living in Nepal and that the number of Nepali students studying in the field was very low.

A student entering SMSTU in 2016 was joining a profession that virtually did not exist in Nepal. After 2016, the situation gradually changed. The Actuarial Society of Nepal (ASN) was established in 2019 and the first actuarial graduates were produced from SMSTU in 2020. During this period, most actuarial work was being done by experts from other countries, including India. Fellow Actuary Prechhya Mathema, who trained in the UK, returned to Nepal in 2018 and became the founding president of ASN. She is widely regarded as the first fully qualified actuary to reside in Nepal.

The regulatory framework also gained momentum with the development of education and the professional community. In May 2024, the Nepal Insurance Authority (NIA) issued a landmark directive mandating the appointment of at least one actuarial analyst in every insurance company. Life insurance companies and reinsurance companies were asked to implement it immediately, while non-life and micro insurance companies were given a specific deadline. This decision is considered a significant achievement for the insurance sector in Nepal.

As of 2026, actuarial science in Nepal is still in its infancy, but it is no longer an unknown subject. SMSTU continues to produce graduates and ASN is now an Associate Member of the International Actuarial Association (IAA). Nepal currently has 37 insurance companies (14 life, 14 non-life, 2 reinsurance and 7 microinsurance), but insurance penetration remains low, with roughly 90 percent of the population lacking insurance coverage. This suggests that demand for actuaries will continue to grow as insurers develop new products, refine premium pricing, and strengthen risk management.

When Edmond Halley published his mortality tables in 1693, he probably never imagined that more than three centuries later, students in Nepal would be using the same concepts to price insurance products and assess financial risk. Actuarial science, which has a history of over 330 years worldwide, has only been in Nepal for a decade. In this short period of time, the profession has evolved from an unknown field of study to become a key pillar of regulatory requirements and the insurance industry. If current trends continue, the next decade may no longer be about introducing actuarial science to Nepal. Rather, it may be the time for Nepal to shape the future of the profession by producing world-class actuaries.

फोटो: केंट विश्वविद्यालय

गिलमोर गर्ल्स देखैत काल हमरा एकटा रोचक दृश्य भेटल जाहि मे लोरेलाई केँ ओकर माय द्वारा एकटा एक्चुअरी सँ परिचय कराओल जाइत छैक । एपिसोड के दौरान एक्चुअरी चर्चा करै छै कि कोना वू बहुत सटीकता स॑ मौत के संभावना के भविष्यवाणी करी सकै छै आरू ऐसनऽ करै लेली एक्चुअरी मॉडल के इस्तेमाल के जिक्र करै छै । एक्चुअरी साइंस के छात्र के रूप में ई दृश्य सचमुच हमर ध्यान आकर्षित केलक। 2000 के दशक के एकटा टेलीविजन सीरियल देखि हमरा उत्साहित छलहुं जाहि में एक्चुअरी, लाइफ टेबल, आ बीमा में ओकर महत्व के चर्चा छल.

एक्चुअरी विज्ञान के इतिहास तीन शताब्दी स॑ भी अधिक पुरानऽ छै । एकरऽ उत्पत्ति १७वीं सदी म॑ सांख्यिकी आरू संभावना सिद्धांत म॑ बढ़तऽ रुचि म॑ छै । ओहि समय सरकार आ व्यापारी लोकनि जनसंख्याक प्रवृत्ति, मृत्यु दर, आ आर्थिक जोखिम कें बुझबा में रुचि रखैत छलाह. मुदा कोनो व्यवस्थित तरीका नहि छल जे लोक कतेक दिन जीवित रहत आ कोनो उम्र मे ओकर मृत्युक संभावना कतेक अछि ।

एहि समस्या कए दूर करबा लेल सबस शुरुआती आंकड़ा मे स एकटा अंग्रेजी सांख्यिकीविद जॉन ग्राउंट छलाह । 1662 में लंदन के “बिल्स ऑफ मॉर्टलिटी” या जन्म आ मृत्यु के रिकॉर्ड के अध्ययन केलनि। भले ही आधुनिक मानक के हिसाब स॑ हुनकऽ काम सरल लगै, लेकिन अपनऽ समय के लेलऽ ई क्रांतिकारी छेलै । पहिलऽ बार विद्वानऽ न॑ वास्तविक आंकड़ा के उपयोग करी क॑ मानव जीवन आरू मृत्यु दर के पैटर्न के मात्रात्मक विश्लेषण करै के कोशिश करलकै । ग्राउंट केरऽ शोध न॑ जनसांख्यिकी, महामारी विज्ञान, आरू अंततः एक्चुअरी विज्ञान केरऽ नींव रखलकै । किछु दशक बाद प्रसिद्ध खगोलशास्त्री एडमंड हैली (जिनका हम आइ हैली के धूमकेतु के लेल बेसी सं बेसी जनैत छी) ग्राउंट के विचार के आओर विकसित केलनि. १६९३ म॑ हुनी ब्रेस्ला शहर (अब व्रोकला, पोलैंड) केरऽ जन्म आरू मृत्यु के रिकॉर्ड के अध्ययन करलकै आरू जीवन वार्षिकी केरऽ मूल्य निर्धारण लेली उपयुक्त पहिलऽ मृत्यु दर तालिका के निर्माण करलकै

हैली केरऽ योगदान मृत्यु दर केरऽ आंकड़ा एकत्रित करै तक सीमित नै छेलै । ओ जीवन वार्षिकी के उचित मूल्य के गणना करय लेल मृत्यु दर के आंकड़ा के उपयोग कोना कएल जाए से देखौलखिन्ह. पहिल बेर बीमा कंपनी आ वित्तीय संस्थान गणितीय रूप स इ निर्धारित क सकैत छल जे कोनो व्यक्ति कए ओकर उम्र आ जीवन प्रत्याशा क आधार पर कतेक पाइ देबय पड़त। एकरा आधुनिक एक्चुअरी विज्ञान के जन्म के रूप में व्यापक रूप स॑ मानलऽ जाय छै । ब्लेस पास्कल, पियरे डी फर्मैट, आ जैकब बर्नौली सन गणितज्ञ संभावना सिद्धांतक तेजीसँ विकास केलनि । हुनकऽ काम न॑ अनिश्चितता के विश्लेषण लेली गणितीय आधार प्रदान करलकै आरू एक्चुअरी गणना क॑ अनुमान स॑ वैज्ञानिक आरू मात्रात्मक मॉडल म॑ बदली देलकै ।

19वीं सदी तक विशेषज्ञ पेशेवर निकाय के उदय के लेल एक्चुअरी पेशे काफी परिपक्व भ गेल छल. 1848 में लंदन में एक्चुअरी संस्थान के स्थापना भेल छल, आ ओकर बाद 1856 में स्कॉटलैंड में एक्चुअरी संकाय के स्थापना भेल छल.ई निकाय सब एक्चुअरी शिक्षा, परीक्षा प्रणाली, आ पेशेवर मानक के औपचारिकता देलक, आ आधुनिक पेशे के विकास में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभेलक.

औद्योगिक क्रांति के दौरान एक्चुअरी के जरूरत तेजी सं बढ़ल, कियाकि पूरा यूरोप आ उत्तरी अमेरिका में जीवन बीमा के विस्तार भेल. एक्चुअरी के जिम्मेदारी प्रीमियम निर्धारित करय, रिजर्व के मूल्यांकन करय, पेंशन योजना के विश्लेषण करय, आ बीमा कंपनी के वित्तीय स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करय के जिम्मेदारी भ गेल. एहि तरहें हुनका लोकनिक भूमिका जीवन प्रत्याशाक गणना सँ आगू बढ़ि गेलनि ।

एक्चुअरी विज्ञान मे 20म शताब्दी मे एकटा आओर पैघ परिवर्तन भेल । ई क्षेत्र जीवन बीमा स॑ ल॑ क॑ स्वास्थ्य बीमा, पेंशन, निवेश, बैंकिंग, सामाजिक सुरक्षा प्रणाली, आरू उद्यम जोखिम प्रबंधन तक के विस्तार करलकै । कंप्यूटिंग तकनीक के विकास स॑ बिग डाटा आरू जटिल वित्तीय प्रणाली के विश्लेषण लेली उन्नत मॉडल के निर्माण संभव होय गेलै । भारत मे एल.एस.वैद्यनाथन 1926 मे पहिल भारतीय फेलो एक्चुअरी बनलाह, जे दक्षिण एशिया लेल एकटा महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि छल । एकरऽ बाद के दशकऽ म॑ पूरा एशिया, अफ्रीका आरू लैटिन अमेरिका म॑ एक्चुअरी शिक्षा आरू पेशेवर संस्थानऽ के स्थापना शुरू होय गेलै ।

आइ एक्चुअरी न केवल बीमा मे काज करैत छथि, बल्कि जलवायु जोखिम, स्वास्थ्य देखभाल वित्तपोषण, आपदा मॉडलिंग, निवेश प्रबंधन, आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (एआई), आ पब्लिक पॉलिसी मे सेहो काज करैत छथि । तकनीक केरऽ बहुत प्रगति के बावजूद ई पेशे केरऽ मूल उद्देश्य वू ही छै जे १६९३ म॑ हैली न॑ परिकल्पित करलकै: अनिश्चितता क॑ समझै लेली गणित आरू सांख्यिकी के उपयोग करना आरू भविष्य के बारे म॑ सूचित निर्णय लेबै म॑ मदद करना ।

अपन दीर्घ वैश्विक इतिहासक बादो नेपाल मे एक्चुअरी विज्ञान अपेक्षाकृत नव विषय अछि । 2010 के दशक तक नेपाल मे नेपाल मे ने कोनो औपचारिक एक्चुअरी शिक्षा कार्यक्रम छल आ ने योग्य एक्चुअरी निवासी। दरअसल, नेपाल मे औपचारिक एक्चुअरी शिक्षा 2016 मे शुरू भेल छल जखन त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय के गणित विज्ञान स्कूल (SMSTU) देश के पहिल बी.मैथ.एससी. (एक्चुअरी साइंस) कार्यक्रम।

ताहि सं पहिने नेपाली बीमा कंपनी सब एक्चुअरी के काज विदेशी कंसल्टेंट के आउटसोर्स क दैत छल, आ अधिकांश छात्र एक्चुअरी प्रोफेशन के नाम तक नहिं सुनने छलाह. The SMSTU itself has noted that “there is a serious shortage of actuaries in the country due to a lack of actuarial education.”

2018 के रिपोर्ट में नेपाल में कोनो योग्य एक्चुअरी नै रहय के बात कहल गेल अछि आ एहि क्षेत्र में पढ़य वाला नेपाली छात्र के संख्या बहुत कम अछि.

A student entering SMSTU in 2016 was joining a profession that virtually did not exist in Nepal. After 2016, the situation gradually changed. नेपाल के एक्चुअरी सोसाइटी (एएसएन) के स्थापना 2019 में भेल छल आ 2020 में एसएमएसटीयू स पहिल एक्चुअरी ग्रेजुएट के उत्पादन भेल छल।एहि दौरान अधिकांश एक्चुअरी के काज भारत सहित अन्य देश के विशेषज्ञ द्वारा कयल जा रहल छल। Fellow Actuary Prechhya Mathema, who trained in the UK, returned to Nepal in 2018 and became the founding president of ASN. She is widely regarded as the first fully qualified actuary to reside in Nepal.

The regulatory framework also gained momentum with the development of education and the professional community. मई 2024 मे नेपाल बीमा प्राधिकरण (एनआईए) एकटा ऐतिहासिक निर्देश जारी केलक जाहि मे हर बीमा कंपनी मे कम स कम एकटा एक्चुअरी विश्लेषक क नियुक्ति अनिवार्य छल। जीवन बीमा कंपनी आ पुनर्बीमा कंपनी कए एकरा तुरंत लागू करबा लेल कहल गेल, जखन कि गैर जीवन आ सूक्ष्म बीमा कंपनी कए एकटा विशिष्ट समय सीमा देल गेल। This decision is considered a significant achievement for the insurance sector in Nepal.

As of 2026, actuarial science in Nepal is still in its infancy, but it is no longer an unknown subject. SMSTU continues to produce graduates and ASN is now an Associate Member of the International Actuarial Association (IAA). नेपाल मे एखन 37 बीमा कंपनी (14 जीवन, 14 गैर-जीवन, 2 पुनर्बीमा आ 7 सूक्ष्म बीमा) अछि, मुदा बीमाक पैठ कम अछि, जाहि मे लगभग 90 प्रतिशत आबादी मे बीमा कवरेज क अभाव अछि। एहि सं पता चलैत अछि जे बीमा कंपनी नव उत्पाद विकसित करय, प्रीमियम मूल्य निर्धारण के परिष्कृत करय, आ जोखिम प्रबंधन के मजबूत करय के संग एक्चुअरी के मांग बढ़ैत रहत.

1693 मे जखन एडमंड हैली अपन मृत्यु दर तालिका प्रकाशित केलथि त शायद हुनका कहियो कल्पना नहि छल जे तीन शताब्दी स बेसी बाद नेपाल मे छात्र बीमा उत्पाद क दाम आ वित्तीय जोखिम क आकलन करबा लेल ओही अवधारणा क उपयोग करताह। Actuarial science, which has a history of over 330 years worldwide, has only been in Nepal for a decade. ई कम समय म॑ ई पेशे अध्ययन केरऽ एगो अज्ञात क्षेत्र स॑ विकसित होय क॑ नियामक आवश्यकता आरू बीमा उद्योग केरऽ एगो प्रमुख स्तंभ बनी गेलऽ छै । If current trends continue, the next decade may no longer be about introducing actuarial science to Nepal. Rather, it may be the time for Nepal to shape the future of the profession by producing world-class actuaries.

title: French-Canadian adventurer completes Nepal’s Great Himalayan Trail in 143 days - The Tourism Times
description: French-Canadian adventurer completes Nepal’s Great Himalayan Trail in 143 days  The Tourism Times
publisher.title: The Tourism Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU: French-Canadian adventurer Stephane Champoussin has completed the full length of Nepal’s Great Himalayan Trail (GHT) in 143 days, crossing some of the country’s most challenging high-altitude terrain and remote settlements.

Champoussin began the journey from Yamphudin in Taplejung on March 17 and reached Hilsa in Humla, the trail’s western terminus, on August 1. He was accompanied by a Sherpa team and supported by porters and guides throughout the expedition.

Pema Sherpa, managing director of Pema Treks & Expeditions, described the expedition as a major achievement, noting the logistical and physical demands involved in completing the high route.

The journey included glacier crossings, high passes, deep snow, rockfalls, river crossings and sections reaching altitudes of around 6,200 metres. A snowstorm near Selele forced the team to seek shelter and later severe weather in the Sherpani Col and Makalu region prompted them to abandon the planned crossing to Chhukung.

The expedition also encountered potentially life-threatening situations. In Rolwaling, a sudden rockfall forced the team to retreat after Temba, one of the team members, raised an immediate warning. On the Tilman Pass section, the team negotiated continuing rockfalls and a swollen river using a whistle warning system and ropes.

Heavy snowfall in the Molun Pokhari area also caused a porters’ tent to collapse, leaving them with little rest before continuing the following day.

Despite the physical challenges, Champoussin said his most memorable experiences came from encounters with people in remote Himalayan communities. He recalled meeting a young girl being raised by her grandmother in Tembathang and said the farewell with her was among the emotional highlights of the journey.

He also observed the hardships faced by people living in remote mountain settlements, including limited access to healthcare and basic medicines. At the same time, he noted gradual improvements brought by roads and solar power.

The final stages included the Manaslu Circuit, a crossing of Thorong La and a visit to Praken Gompa, where he received blessings from an Ani, or Buddhist nun.

Champoussin and his team reached Hilsa on August 1, where they learned of the fatal Broad Peak accident that claimed the lives of six Nepali mountain guides. Reflecting on the tragedy, he said the mountains had once again demonstrated both their possibilities and dangers.

Champoussin credited his porters Temba, Pemkipa, Dawa and Rasan, guides Sonam and Sange, and the Kathmandu-based team of Pema Treks for helping complete the expedition.

He advised future GHT trekkers not to underestimate the route, particularly its glacier crossings, extreme altitude and exposed sections.

“For fit trekkers, don’t underestimate the Himalayas,” he said, adding that embracing the challenges ultimately turns them into lasting memories.

चम्पौसिन न॑ 17 मार्च क॑ ताप्लेजंग केरऽ यम्फूडिन स॑ यात्रा शुरू करलकै आरू 1 अगस्त क॑ ट्रेल केरऽ पश्चिमी टर्मिनस हुमला केरऽ हिल्सा पहुँचलै ।हुनी के साथ एगो शेर्पा टीम भी छेलै आरू पूरा अभियान म॑ पोर्टर आरू गाइड केरऽ सहयोग छेलै ।

पेमा ट्रेक्स एंड एक्सपीडिएशंस केरऽ प्रबंध निदेशक पेमा शेर्पा न॑ ई अभियान क॑ एगो बड़ऽ उपलब्धि बतैलकै आरू उच्च मार्ग क॑ पूरा करै म॑ शामिल रसद आरू भौतिक मांग क॑ नोट करलकै ।

एहि यात्रा मे ग्लेशियर क्रॉसिंग, हाई पास, गहींर बर्फ, चट्टानी झरना, नदी पार करब आ लगभग 6200 मीटर क ऊंचाई पर पहुंचय वाला खंड शामिल छल। सेलेले के पास बर्फबारी के कारण टीम क॑ शरण लेबै ल॑ पड़लै आरू बाद म॑ शेरपानी कर्नल आरू मकालू क्षेत्र केरऽ भयंकर मौसम के वजह स॑ ओकरा सिनी क॑ चुकुंग लेली योजनाबद्ध क्रासिंग छोड़ी देलऽ गेलै ।

ई अभियान म॑ संभावित जानलेवा परिस्थिति के सामना भी करलऽ गेलै । रोलवालिंग म॑ अचानक चट्टान गिरला के बाद टीम केरऽ सदस्यऽ म॑ स॑ एक टेम्बा न॑ तुरंत चेतावनी देला के बाद टीम क॑ पीछे हटै ल॑ पड़लै । तिलमन दर्रा खंड पर टीम न॑ सीटी चेतावनी प्रणाली आरू रस्सी के इस्तेमाल करी क॑ लगातार चट्टान गिरै आरू सूजलऽ नदी के बातचीत करलकै ।

मोलुन पोखरी इलाका में भारी बर्फबारी के कारण एकटा पोर्टर के डेरा सेहो गिर गेल छल, जाहि सं अगिला दिन जारी रखबा सं पहिने हुनका सब के कम आराम भेटल छल.

शारीरिक चुनौती के बावजूद चम्पौसिन नँ कहलकै कि हुनकऽ सबसें यादगार अनुभव दूरस्थ हिमालयी समुदाय के लोगऽ स॑ मुठभेड़ स॑ मिललै । ओ टेम्बाथांग मे ओकर दादी द्वारा पलल-बढ़ल एकटा छोट बच्ची सँ भेंट करबाक स्मरण करैत कहलनि जे हुनका संग विदाई यात्राक भावुक आकर्षण मे सँ एक छल ।

ओ दूरस्थ पहाड़ी बस्ती मे रहय वाला लोक के परेशानी के सेहो देखलखिन्ह, जाहि मे स्वास्थ्य सेवा आओर बेसिक दवाई के सीमित पहुंच शामिल अछि. एकरऽ साथ ही सड़क आरू सौर ऊर्जा के कारण धीरे-धीरे सुधार के बात भी नोट करलकै ।

अंतिम चरण में मनसलू सर्किट, थोरोंग ला के पार आरू प्राकेन गोम्पा के दौरा शामिल छेलै, जहां हुनका एक आनी या बौद्ध नन स॑ आशीर्वाद मिललै ।

चम्पौसिन आरू हुनकऽ टीम १ अगस्त क॑ हिल्सा पहुँचलै, जहां ओकरा सब क॑ ब्रॉड पीक केरऽ घातक दुर्घटना के जानकारी मिललै जेकरा म॑ छह नेपाली माउंटेन गाइड के जान गेलऽ छेलै । एहि त्रासदी पर चिंतन करैत ओ कहला जे पहाड़ एक बेर फेर अपन संभावना आ खतरा दुनू क प्रदर्शन केलक अछि।

चम्पौसिन न॑ अपनऽ पोर्टर टेम्बा, पेमकिपा, दावा आरू रसन, गाइड सोनम आरू सांगे, आरू काठमांडू स्थित पेमा ट्रेक्स केरऽ टीम क॑ ई अभियान क॑ पूरा करै म॑ मदद करै के श्रेय देलकै ।

हुनी भविष्य केरऽ जीएचटी ट्रेकर्स क॑ सलाह देलकै कि ई मार्ग खास करी क॑ एकरऽ ग्लेशियर क्रॉसिंग, चरम ऊंचाई आरू उजागर खंड क॑ कम नै आंक॑ ।

ओ कहलनि जे, फिट ट्रेकर्स के लेल हिमालय के कम नहिं आंकू आ चुनौती के गले लगाबय सं अंततः ओकरा स्थायी याद में बदलि जाइत अछि.

full_article:
Nepali Prime Minister Balendra Shah engaged in a significant diplomatic meeting with Indian Ambassador to Nepal, Naveen Srivastava, marking the first one-on-one discussion since Shah's ascension to office in March. This courtesy call is part of a series of individual talks the Prime Minister is scheduling with foreign envoys, signaling a notable shift toward personalized diplomacy.

The meeting took place at Singha Durbar, involving discussions with the Council of Ministers. Both parties delved into aspects of the Indo-Nepal relationship, emphasizing bilateral friendship and mutual cooperation. Ambassador Srivastava conveyed his best wishes to Shah and reiterated India's dedication to fortifying the ties between the two nations.

Prime Minister Shah, acknowledging the historical connection between India and Nepal, stressed the necessity for collaboration in areas of shared interest. Notably, this meeting represents Shah's first face-to-face engagement with an individual foreign diplomat, deviating from his earlier preference for group interactions. Shah's diplomatic itinerary includes scheduled talks with Chinese Ambassador Zhang Maoming and US Charge d'Affaires Scott Urbom.

Nepal's partnership with India dates back to 1951 with initiatives like the Gauchar Airport construction and the establishment of the Indian Aid Mission in 1954, focusing on sectors spanning health, education, and more. Over the decades, Indo-Nepal development cooperation has significantly expanded, catering to Nepal's diverse needs and priorities across the country.

(With inputs from agencies.)

title: Nepal PM Balen Shah meets Indian envoy Naveen Srivastava in 1st high-level diplomatic engagement - theprint.in
description: Nepal PM Balen Shah meets Indian envoy Naveen Srivastava in 1st high-level diplomatic engagement  theprint.in
publisher.title: theprint.in
full_article:
The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu said the discussions focused on further strengthening bilateral relations and expanding cooperation within the longstanding, multidimensional partnership between the two countries.

Shah, who became prime minister on 27 March, has not previously been reported to have met with an ambassador representing any of Nepal’s neighboring countries since assuming office.

His engagement with India comes after an earlier diplomatic setback. Shah was earlier supposed to meet India’s foreign secretary, Vikram Misri, during a proposed visit to Nepal on 11 May. Misri’s trip was subsequently postponed at the last minute.

The new Nepal government has invited Misri to visit, but no confirmed date has been set.

The meeting with Srivastava now marks a shift toward more direct diplomatic engagement between the two countries.

Shah is also scheduled to meet the Chinese envoy later.

The outreach comes as the Shah government confronts a range of domestic and foreign-policy challenges and works to establish its diplomatic priorities.

India and Nepal maintain extensive ties spanning trade, energy, infrastructure, security and people-to-people connections. Their relationship has at times been complicated by disagreements over borders, trade and political influence.

Six months after Nepal’s Rastriya Swatantra Party swept to power riding on a wave of anti-establishment sentiment, the uneasiness between its two most prominent figures, Balendra Shah and RSP chairman Rabi Lamichhane, is manifesting through disputes over party rules, cabinet appointments, and foreign policy.

The meeting with the Chinese envoy also comes after a conference on Tibetan studies scheduled to take place in Nepal this month was cancelled at the request of government officials.

The International Association for Tibetan Studies seminar scheduled for 23-26 August was expected to bring together scholars and delegates from several countries. It was to be hosted by the Himalaya Centre for Asian Studies at Kathmandu University.

Nepal has long maintained close relations with China and has generally barred activities supporting the Tibetan independence movement or other pro-Tibetan political causes.

काठमांडू स्थित भारतीय दूतावास कहलनि जे, दुनू देशक बीच दीर्घकालीन, बहुआयामी साझेदारी के भीतर द्विपक्षीय संबंध के आओर मजबूत करय आ सहयोग के विस्तार पर चर्चा केन्द्रित अछि।

27 मार्च कए प्रधानमंत्री बनल शाह कए पदभार ग्रहण क बाद स पहिने नेपाल क कोनो पड़ोसी देश क प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला राजदूत स भेंट करबाक खबर नहि आयल अछि।

भारत के साथ हुनकऽ जुड़ाव पहिने के कूटनीतिक झटका के बाद आबी रहलऽ छै । शाह क॑ पहल॑ ११ मई क॑ नेपाल केरऽ प्रस्तावित यात्रा के दौरान भारत केरऽ विदेश सचिव विक्रम मिश्री स॑ भेंट करै के छेलै । एकर बाद मिसरी’क यात्रा अंतिम समय मे स्थगित भ’ गेलै.

नव नेपाल सरकार मिश्री केँ घुमबाक लेल आमंत्रित केलक अछि, मुदा कोनो पुष्टि तिथि निर्धारित नहि कएल गेल अछि ।

श्रीवास्तव के साथ ई मुलाकात अब॑ दूनू देशऽ के बीच आरू सीधा कूटनीतिक जुड़ाव के तरफ बढ़ै के बात सामने ऐलऽ छै ।

शाह के बाद में चीनी दूत सं सेहो भेंट करय के अछि.

ई आउटरीच ऐन्हऽ समय म॑ करलऽ गेलऽ छै जब॑ शाह सरकार क॑ घरेलू आरू विदेश-नीति केरऽ कई तरह के चुनौती के सामना करना पड़॑ छै आरू वू अपनऽ कूटनीतिक प्राथमिकता स्थापित करै के काम करी रहलऽ छै ।

भारत आ नेपाल व्यापार, ऊर्जा, बुनियादी ढांचा, सुरक्षा आ जनता सं जुड़ाव कें व्यापक संबंध बनौने छै. सीमा, व्यापार आ राजनीतिक प्रभाव पर मतभेद के कारण हुनकर संबंध कखनो काल जटिल भ गेल अछि ।

नेपाल केरऽ राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्र पार्टी न॑ संस्थापन विरोधी भावना केरऽ लहर प॑ सवार होय क॑ सत्ता म॑ आबै के छह महीना बाद ओकरऽ दू सबसें प्रमुख हस्ती बलेन्द्र शाह आरू आरएसपी केरऽ अध्यक्ष रबी लामिछाने के बीच के बेचैनी पार्टी केरऽ नियम, मंत्रिमंडल केरऽ नियुक्ति, आरू विदेश नीति के विवाद के माध्यम स॑ प्रकट होय रहलऽ छै ।

चीन के दूत के संग ई बैसार सरकारी अधिकारी के आग्रह पर एहि मास नेपाल मे होबय वाला तिब्बती अध्ययन के सम्मेलन रद्द करय के बाद सेहो भेल अछि.

23-26 अगस्त क॑ होबै वाला इंटरनेशनल एसोसिएशन फॉर तिब्बती स्टडीज सेमिनार म॑ कई देशऽ के विद्वान आरू प्रतिनिधि सिनी के एक साथ आबै के उम्मीद छेलै । एकर आयोजन काठमांडू विश्वविद्यालय के हिमालय सेंटर फॉर एशियन स्टडीज के तरफ सं होबय वाला छल.

नेपाल चीन के साथ बहुत दिन स॑ घनिष्ठ संबंध रखै छै आरू सामान्य तौर प॑ तिब्बती स्वतंत्रता आन्दोलन या अन्य तिब्बती समर्थक राजनीतिक काज के समर्थन करै वाला गतिविधि प॑ रोक लगाय देल॑ छै ।

China's Ambassador to Nepal, Zhang Maoming, on Monday called on Prime Minister Balendra Shah and discussed bilateral ties, mutual interests, development partnership and cooperation, according to the Prime Minister's Office.

The meeting came as Shah continued a series of diplomatic engagements. Earlier in the day, he met Indian Ambassador to Nepal Naveen Srivastava, and he is also scheduled to meet the US Embassy Charge d'Affaires on Tuesday.

Ambassador Zhang paid a courtesy call on Shah at Singhadurbar, the Prime Minister's Office said. “Matters relating to further strengthening Nepal-China relations, promoting cooperation in various fields and advancing development partnership were discussed on the occasion,” it said in a statement.

During the meeting, Shah stressed the need to further deepen Nepal's historical ties with China and work together in areas of common interest, the statement said. Zhang conveyed his best wishes to the Prime Minister and pledged to further strengthen mutual relations and cooperation between the two countries.

Source: Yadea LinkedIn – All images © Yadea | Yadea has begun rolling out its GT80 electric maxi-scooter across three Asian markets in recent weeks, with the model now confirmed in Indonesia, Thailand and Nepal.

Indonesia launch

Yadea Indonesia introduced the GT80 through an online reveal on its TikTok channel, positioning the scooter as a Grand Touring model aimed at long-distance comfort rather than pure city commuting. The Indonesian version features an aerodynamic bodywork with a blade-like front fascia and a tapered tail light, plus a full-LED lighting system. Equipment includes Traction Control, Hill Descent Control, Hill Hold Control, reverse mode, cruise control, Combined Braking System and smartphone map mirroring. A dual-battery configuration is available in this market, extending range up to 190 km under WMTC testing.

YADEA INDONESIA >

Thailand launch

In Thailand, Yadea introduced the GT80 as part of its premium electric maxi-scooter range, without disclosing detailed specifications at launch. The brand has positioned the model there as a flagship addition to its local lineup. Yang Xiaofei, CEO of Yadea Technology (Thailand) Co., Ltd., the manufacturer and distributor of Yadea electric vehicles in Thailand, said that to reinforce their leadership in smart electric vehicles with a global business base and nine consecutive years as the top-selling electric two-wheeler brand, launching the GT80 and GT80-P models under the “New Freedom, Go Further” concept marks an important moment. Consumers are increasingly seeking new options to reduce daily travel costs, especially amid rising fuel prices and travel expenses influencing purchasing decisions. (Source: Thairat Online >)

YADEA THAILAND >

Yang said, “Consumers currently worry about travel range, long charging times, insufficient charging points, and after-sales service. The GT80 models are designed to address these concerns, offering longer travel distances that help reduce costs. Additionally, the GT80 and GT80-P are built to handle Thailand’s weather conditions, being waterproof, sun-resistant, and rainproof, making them suitable for all usage scenarios.”

Nepal launch

Kuzu Nepal Pvt. Ltd, Yadea’s authorized distributor in Nepal, launched the GT80 in Kathmandu on August 6 alongside two other new models, the GS70 and GT70. The Nepal-spec GT80 is priced at NPR 365,000 (later listed by some outlets at NPR 335,000) and comes with a 3.6 kWh lithium battery paired with a 5 kW peak motor, giving a top speed of 80 km/h and a claimed range of up to 150 km. It shares the smart connectivity suite used across the Nepal lineup – Bluetooth, a TFT display, navigation mirroring, the Yadea Smart App with five-user family sharing, and keyless access – along with Traction Control, cruise control, Hill Hold and Hill Descent Control, and dual disc brakes. The GT80 is available through 20 authorized Yadea dealerships in Nepal, backed by a 3-year or 50,000 km battery warranty. Kuzu Nepal is offering a NPR 10,000 introductory discount on the model through the end of the NAIMA Nepal Mobility Expo 2026.

YADEA NEPAL >

Regional differences

The specifications disclosed for Indonesia and Nepal differ substantially – battery capacity, motor output and claimed range are not consistent between the two markets – indicating Yadea is tailoring the GT80 to local regulatory or market requirements rather than distributing a single global configuration.

title: Finance minister urges multinationals to expand investment, production and jobs in Nepal - Khabarhub
description: Finance minister urges multinationals to expand investment, production and jobs in Nepal  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Finance Minister Dr Swarnim Wagle has said protecting legally made investments, created assets and earned profits is a major responsibility of the government.

Speaking at a meeting with representatives of 20 major multinational companies at the Ministry of Finance on Monday, Wagle urged the companies to increase investment, expand their industries, introduce new products and bring new technologies into Nepal.

He assured the representatives that the government would support their efforts.

“Entrepreneurs must be able to trust that their assets are secure, rules are stable, the tax system is predictable and the state stands as their partner,” Wagle said. “Without building that trust, large investments will not come and industries will not expand. Only by building that trust can economic transformation become possible.”

Wagle described the meeting as more than a formal interaction, saying it marked an effort to establish deeper trust, cooperation and commitment between the government and the private sector, which he said plays a leading role in nation-building.

He said issues raised by the business representatives would be coordinated with the relevant ministries within specified timelines. The Ministry of Finance would also establish a “response desk” to monitor the implementation of commitments, he said.

According to Wagle, dialogue between the government and private sector would continue until the issues raised by businesses are resolved.

“We want to create an environment where society takes pride in the success of industries, investors feel secure, taxpayers are respected and young people are encouraged to become entrepreneurs,” he said.

Wagle said the government was working to make Nepal a more investment-friendly, business-friendly and production-oriented economy.

He also stressed the need to further strengthen the partnership between the government and private sector, expressing confidence that the coming decade would become a decade of greater investment, production, employment and confidence in Nepal.

Representatives from 20 companies participated in the meeting, including Surya Nepal, Ncell Axiata, Aarti Strips, Gorkha Brewery, Himalaya Airlines, Hongshi Shivam Cement, Doosan Enerbility, Dabur Nepal, Bottlers Nepal (Terai), Unilever Nepal, Asian Paints Nepal, Power Construction Corporation of China, Gorkha Lahari, Huaxin Cement Narayani, New Hope Agro Business Nepal, Nepal Wellhope Agri-Tech, Varun Beverages Nepal, Turkish Airlines, Bhotekoshi Power Company and Berger Jenson & Nicholson Nepal.

ओ कहलनि जे, हम एहन माहौल बनाबय चाहैत छी जतय समाज उद्योग के सफलता पर गर्व करय, निवेशक सुरक्षित महसूस करय, करदाता के सम्मान करय आ युवा के उद्यमी बनय लेल प्रोत्साहित करय।

वागले कहलनि जे, सरकार नेपाल केँ बेसी निवेश-अनुकूल, व्यवसाय-अनुकूल आ उत्पादन-उन्मुख अर्थव्यवस्था बनेबाक लेल काज क’ रहल अछि।

ओ सरकार आ निजी क्षेत्रक बीच साझेदारी आओर मजबूत करबाक आवश्यकता पर सेहो जोर देलनि, आगामी दशक नेपाल मे बेसी निवेश, उत्पादन, रोजगार आ विश्वासक दशक बनत ताहि पर विश्वास व्यक्त केलनि।

बैसारमे सूर्य नेपाल, एनसेल एक्सियाटा, आरती स्ट्रिप्स, गोरखा ब्रूअरी, हिमालय एयरलाइंस, होंगशी शिवम सीमेंट, दूसन एनर्बिलिटी, डाबर नेपाल, बाटलर्स नेपाल (तराई), यूनिलिवर नेपाल, एशियन पेंट्स नेपाल, पावर कंस्ट्रक्शन कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ चाइना, गोरखा लहरी, हुअक्सिन सीमेंट नारायणी, न्यू होप सहित २० कम्पनीक प्रतिनिधि भाग लेलनि एग्रो बिजनेस नेपाल, नेपाल वेलहोप एग्री-टेक, वरुण बेवरेज नेपाल, तुर्की एयरलाइंस, भोटेकोशी पावर कम्पनी आ बर्गर जेन्सन एंड निकोलसन नेपाल।

title: Foreign minister says it’s unclear whether Nepal has signed copy of Sugauli Treaty - The Kathmandu Post
description: Foreign minister says it’s unclear whether Nepal has signed copy of Sugauli Treaty  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
At a time when the Nepal-India border dispute has intensified following India and China’s agreement to reopen the Lipulekh trade route, Nepal says it cannot locate the original 1816 Sugauli Treaty that established its boundary with British India.

Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal said it remains unclear whether Nepal has an official copy of the treaty signed with Britain.

Responding to a query in the House of Representatives by Nishkal Rai, Khanal said,“The Government of Nepal does not have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents. There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we do not have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties.” Nepal, however, has documents related to the 1816 treaty and the 1950 treaties, he said.

The treaty provided the basis for the demarcation of the boundary between Nepal and then British India.

In 2016, when the Eminent Persons’ Group on Nepal-India Relations began discussions on reviewing or replacing the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship, the Nepali side attempted to locate the original document, signed by then Prime Minister Mohan Shumsher and Indian Ambassador to Nepal Chandeshwar Prasad Narayan Singh. It failed to find the original.

The government subsequently provided the Bhekh Bahadur Thapa-led committee with a second copy of the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship.

This prompted a parliamentary inquiry into the whereabouts of the original documents. On July 22, the Delegated Legislation and Governance Committee of the National Assembly concluded that the original copies of both the Sugauli Treaty and the Nepal-India Treaty of Peace and Friendship could not be found in Nepal. The committee said it had conducted a thorough search of all possible locations where historical documents might be preserved, including libraries, archives and repositories, as well as the Department of Archaeology, Narayanhiti Palace Museum, Ministry of Law and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

The issue had also been raised in the House of Representatives in 2019. Then Foreign Minister Pradeep Gyawali said his ministry possessed copies of both treaties but was uncertain whether they were the originals.

“We have both treaties, but we have to forensically verify whether these copies are originals or not,” Gyawali said. “We are also trying to find historical documents and maps in India and the United Kingdom.”

The Treaty of Sugauli, signed between Nepal and the East India Company in 1815, marked a significant turning point in Nepal’s history. Following Nepal’s defeat in the Anglo-Nepal War, the treaty required the country to cede large parts of its territory. Signed by Parish Bradshaw on behalf of the Company and Raj Guru Gajaraj Mishra on behalf of Nepal, the treaty largely defined Nepal’s territorial boundaries and its relationship with British India.

Similarly, the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship, signed between the then Rana government and the Government of India, established provisions granting Nepalis and Indians reciprocal rights in several areas in each other’s countries. The treaty helped shape the relationship between democratic Nepal and independent India and has long been criticised by some sections of Nepal’s political establishment as “unequal.”

Foreign Minister Khanal has also said that Nepal will review its treaties and agreements with the country’s national interests at the centre. He made the statement on Monday while responding to questions in the House of Representatives.

Khanal said Nepal has a total of 655 treaties and agreements—412 bilateral agreements with neighbouring countries, other friendly nations, regional organisations and other parties, and 243 multilateral agreements.

Of these, 55 treaties and agreements have so far been concluded or amended, he said. The government plans to review, amend and renew the remaining 600 treaties and agreements based on their necessity and relevance, Khanal said.

He added that old and inactive treaties and agreements would be reviewed, amended and renewed in coordination with the respective countries and organisations. Khanal was responding to a question from Nepali Congress lawmaker and Chief Whip Rai during Monday’s House of Representatives meeting.

“It is a fact that, as stated in the report submitted pursuant to Article 53 of the Constitution of Nepal, treaties and agreements will be reviewed, amended, and renewed and brought into implementation based on necessity and relevance, in accordance with decisions of the Government of Nepal,” Khanal said.

He added, “Under the general principles of international treaty law, the review, amendment, or renewal of any bilateral or multilateral treaty or agreement depends on the mutual consent and approval of the concerned state parties or relevant international organisations. This is an established practice under international law and diplomacy.”

For this reason, Khanal said, the government would proceed with the review, amendment and renewal of such treaties and agreements in cooperation with, and with the approval of, the relevant friendly countries or international organisations.

भारत आरू चीन केरऽ लिपुलेख व्यापार मार्ग क॑ फेर स॑ खोलै के समझौता के बाद जब॑ नेपाल-भारत सीमा विवाद तेज होय गेलऽ छै, वू समय म॑ नेपाल के कहना छै कि वू १८१६ केरऽ मूल सुगौली संधि के पता नै लगाय सकै छै जेकरा स॑ ब्रिटिश भारत के साथ ओकरऽ सीमा स्थापित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

विदेश मंत्री शिसिर खनाल कहलनि जे, ब्रिटेन के संग हस्ताक्षरित संधि के आधिकारिक प्रति नेपाल लग अछि कि नहि से एखन धरि स्पष्ट नहि अछि।

निष्कल राय द्वारा प्रतिनिधि सभा मे पूछल गेल प्रश्नक उत्तर दैत खनाल कहलनि जे, “नेपाल सरकार लग एहि बातक स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे हमरा सब लग आधिकारिक संधि दस्तावेज अछि वा नहि। एहन अभिलेख अछि जे किछु खास संधि स संबंधित किछु दस्तावेज राष्ट्रीय अभिलेखागार मे राखल गेल अछि।मुदा हमरा सब लग स्पष्ट जानकारी नहि अछि जे ओ वास्तविक आधिकारिक संधि अछि कि नहि।” ओना नेपाल मे १८१६ के संधि आ १९५० के संधि स संबंधित दस्तावेज अछि ओ कहलनि ।

ई संधि नेपाल आ तत्कालीन ब्रिटिश भारत के बीच सीमा के सीमांकन के आधार प्रदान केलक ।

2016 मे जखन नेपाल-भारत संबंध पर प्रख्यात व्यक्ति समूह 1950 के शांति आ मैत्री संधि के समीक्षा या बदलय के चर्चा शुरू केलक त नेपाली पक्ष मूल दस्तावेज के पता लगेबाक प्रयास केलक, जाहि पर तत्कालीन प्रधानमंत्री मोहन शुमशेर आ नेपाल मे भारतीय राजदूत चंदेश्वर प्रसाद नारायण सिंह के हस्ताक्षर छल. मूल खोजबा मे असफल रहल।

तत्पश्चात सरकार भेख बहादुर थापा नेतृत्व समिति के १९५० के शान्ति आ मैत्री संधि के दोसर प्रति उपलब्ध करौलक ।

एहि स मूल दस्तावेज क ठिकाना क संसदीय जांच शुरू भ गेल। 22 जुलाई कए राष्ट्रीय सभा क प्रत्यायोजित विधान आ शासन समिति क निष्कर्ष छल जे सुगौली संधि आ नेपाल-भारत शान्ति आ मैत्री सन्धि दुनू क मूल प्रति नेपाल मे नहि भेट सकैत अछि । समिति नँ कहलकै कि हुनी पुस्तकालय, अभिलेखागार आरू भंडार सहित सब संभावित स्थानौ के गहन खोज करलकै, जेकरा मँ पुस्तकालय, अभिलेखागार आरू भंडार के साथ-साथ पुरातत्व विभाग, नारायणहिती पैलेस संग्रहालय, कानून मंत्रालय आरू विदेश मंत्रालय शामिल छै ।

ई मुद्दा 2019 म॑ प्रतिनिधि सभा म॑ भी उठलऽ छेलै ।तत्कालीन विदेश मंत्री प्रदीप ग्यावाली न॑ कहलकै कि हुनकऽ मंत्रालय के पास दूनू संधि केरऽ प्रतिलिपि छै लेकिन ई अनिश्चित छै कि ई मूल संधि छेकै कि नै ।

ग्यावाली कहला जे हमरा सब लग दुनू संधि अछि, मुदा हमरा सब कए फोरेंसिक तरीका स इ सत्यापन करय पड़त जे इ प्रतिलिपि मूल अछि या नहि। “हम भारत आरू यूनाइटेड किंगडम म॑ ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज आरू नक्शा भी खोजै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छियै।”

1815 मे नेपाल आ ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के बीच भेल सुगौली संधि नेपाल के इतिहास मे एकटा महत्वपूर्ण मोड़ छल. एंग्लो-नेपाल युद्ध मे नेपाल के हार के बाद एहि संधि मे देश के अपन इलाका के पैघ हिस्सा सौंपल गेल छल. कंपनी के तरफ स॑ परिषद ब्रैडशॉ आरू नेपाल के तरफ स॑ राज गुरु गजराज मिश्र के हस्ताक्षर वाला ई संधि म॑ नेपाल केरऽ क्षेत्रीय सीमा आरू ब्रिटिश भारत स॑ ओकरऽ संबंध क॑ काफी हद तलक परिभाषित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

तहिना तत्कालीन राणा सरकार आ भारत सरकार के बीच भेल 1950 के शांति आ मैत्री संधि में नेपाली आ भारतीय के एक दोसरा के देश में कतेको क्षेत्र में पारस्परिक अधिकार देबय के प्रावधान स्थापित कयल गेल छल | ई संधि लोकतांत्रिक नेपाल आरू स्वतंत्र भारत के बीच के संबंध क॑ आकार दै म॑ मदद करलकै आरू नेपाल केरऽ राजनीतिक संस्थापन केरऽ कुछ वर्ग न॑ बहुत दिन स॑ एकरऽ आलोचना “असमान” के रूप म॑ करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै ।

विदेश मंत्री खनाल सेहो कहलनि जे नेपाल केन्द्र मे देशक राष्ट्रीय हित के संग अपन संधि आ समझौता के समीक्षा करत। ओ सोमदिन प्रतिनिधि सभा मे सवालक जवाब दैत ई बयान देलनि।

खनाल नँ कहलकै कि नेपाल मँ कुल ६५५ संधि आरू समझौता छै-पड़ोसी देश, अन्य मित्र राष्ट्र, क्षेत्रीय संगठन आरू अन्य दल के साथ ४१२ द्विपक्षीय समझौता, आरू २४३ बहुपक्षीय समझौता ।

ओ कहला जे एहि मे स एखन धरि 55टा संधि आ समझौता भ चुकल अछि या संशोधन भ चुकल अछि। खनाल कहला जे सरकार शेष 600 संधि आ समझौता क आवश्यकता आ प्रासंगिकता क आधार पर समीक्षा, संशोधन आ नवीकरण करबाक योजना बना रहल अछि।

हुनी आरू कहलकै कि संबंधित देश आरू संगठन के साथ समन्वय स॑ पुरानऽ आरू निष्क्रिय संधि आरू समझौता के समीक्षा, संशोधन आरू नवीनीकरण करलऽ जैतै । खनाल सोमदिन प्रतिनिधि सभा के बैसार के दौरान नेपाली कांग्रेस के विधायक आ मुख्य सचेतक राय के सवाल के जवाब द रहल छलाह.

खनाल कहलनि जे, नेपाल सरकार के निर्णय के अनुसार, नेपाल के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 53 के अनुसार प्रस्तुत रिपोर्ट में कहल गेल अछि, संधि आ समझौता के समीक्षा, संशोधन, आ नवीकरण आ आवश्यकता आ प्रासंगिकता के आधार पर क्रियान्वयन में आनल जायत।

हुनी आरू कहलकै, "अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संधि कानून के सामान्य सिद्धांत के तहत कोनो भी द्विपक्षीय या बहुपक्षीय संधि या समझौता के समीक्षा, संशोधन, या नवीकरण संबंधित राज्य पक्ष या संबंधित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संगठन के आपसी सहमति आरू मंजूरी प निर्भर करै छै ।ई अंतरराष्ट्रीय कानून आरू कूटनीति के तहत एगो स्थापित प्रथा छै।"

खनाल नँ कहलकै कि ई कारण स॑ सरकार संबंधित दोस्त देश या अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संगठनऽ के सहयोग स॑ आरू ओकरऽ मंजूरी स॑ ऐसनऽ संधि आरू समझौता के समीक्षा, संशोधन आरू नवीकरण के काम आगू बढ़तै ।

description: Five bodies recovered in eastern Nepal after November avalanche  Yahoo

The bodies of five mountaineers who went missing in an avalanche in eastern Nepal in November have been recovered, Nepalese authorities announced on Monday.

They included two Nepalese mountain guides and three foreigners - a German, an Italian and a Canadian - the deputy police chief of Dolakha district Manoj Kumar Lama told dpa.

Lama corrected an earlier official statement that said five foreign mountaineers had gone missing. The accident occurred on the 5,630-meter-high Yalung Ri in eastern Nepal, near the border with Tibet.

title: Israel's Trade Envoy Praises Nepal's Honesty and Nepali Workers - Ratopati
description: Israel's Trade Envoy Praises Nepal's Honesty and Nepali Workers  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Israel. Israel's Special Envoy for Trade and Innovation and former Deputy Mayor of Jerusalem, Fleur Hassan Nahoum, has praised her close relationship with Nepal and the honesty of Nepalis.

Speaking with an 18-member Nepali journalist delegation on a visit to Israel, she said that Nepal has always been special to her.

Nahoum recalled visiting Nepal 28 years ago during her honeymoon. Recounting her experience of visiting Everest Base Camp (EBC), Kathmandu, and surrounding areas with her husband, she mentioned that she was impressed by Nepali food and the behavior of the people. She also expressed her desire to visit Nepal again.

Speaking about the contribution of Nepali workers in Israel, Nahoum said that the role of caregivers is particularly important. title: Nepal PM Balen Shah Balances Ties Between India And China, Seeks To Draw On 'Historical Ties' - ETV Bharat
description: Nepal PM Balen Shah Balances Ties Between India And China, Seeks To Draw On 'Historical Ties'  ETV Bharat
publisher.title: ETV Bharat
full_article:
Kathmandu: Nepal Prime Minister Balen Shah's meetings with the Indian and Chinese envoys on Monday provided a first glimpse into how he plans to balance Nepal's ties with its two larger neighbours.

Hours after he met Indian ambassador Naveen Srivastava at the Prime Minister’s Office in Singha Durbar, he met Chinese ambassador Zhang Maoming.

In both his meetings with the Indian and Chinese envoys, Shah, who has revealed very little about his foreign policy, said he wanted to deepen Nepal's historic relationship with India and China respectively.

That Shah met first with the Indian ambassador and then the Chinese ambassador could in itself send a strong diplomatic message, noted analysts. PM Shah is expected to next meet with the top US Embassy official.

The Prime Minister’s Office said in a social media post that the separate meetings with Indian and Chinese envoys focused on “further strengthening” relations, “promoting bilateral cooperation and enhancing development partnership for the mutual benefit”.

Analysts noted that the meeting was long overdue as Shah, who had avoided one-on-one meetings with foreign ambassadors posted to Kathmandu, turned his attention from domestic issues to Nepal's engagement with India and China.

“I think such meetings were long overdue; they should have happened soon after he assumed office,” Dinesh Bhattarai, the foreign affairs advisor to former prime minister Sushil Koirala, told ETV Bharat.

“I think it indicates the much-needed realisation that Nepal ought to have fantastic relations with its immediate neighbours, India and China, as well as the distant superpower, the United States.”

Shah is also expected to meet envoys of other friendly countries, including the United Kingdom, key EU member states and East Asian countries, which are Nepal’s key donors and development partners.

Shah has largely avoided individual meetings with the diplomatic corps even as he had focused on domestic issues.

title: Bill on protecting existing provisions of Nepal's Special Services Act passed - The Rising Nepal
description: Bill on protecting existing provisions of Nepal's Special Services Act passed  The Rising Nepal

full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 10: The meeting today of the House of Representatives unanimously passed the Bill on protecting existing provisions of Nepal's Special Services Act, 2042 (2083).

The bill was passed after Speaker Dol Prasad Aryal presented it in the House meeting for a decision.

Earlier, on behalf of Prime Minister Balendra Shah, Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, had presented a proposal seeking passage of the bill.

The meeting had also unanimously approved the proposal seeking discussion on the Bill, along with the report of the State Affairs and Good Governance Committee.

The proposal was presented on behalf of Prime Minister Shah by Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Gautam.

Minister Gautam said that it would be better if the investigating agency reached out to the Prime Minister with all kinds of information, and since overall security situation of the country should be a matter of direct concern of the Prime Minister it should be under the Prime Minister's Office.

She said that this bill seeks to place the National Investigation Bureau under the Prime Minister's Office, as also all types of investigation should be carried out by intelligence agencies, not limiting it to the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Earlier, MPs Shristi Bhattarai, Lalita Kumari, Ganesh Bahadur Bishwakarma, Deepak Kumar Shah, Shahzaan Khatun, Yashodha Kumari Baral, and Sazida Khatun Siddique participated in the discussion on the Bill and shared their views and suggestions.

The next meeting of the House of Representatives will be held at 1:00 pm tomorrow (Tuesday).

Earlier, the meeting approved by a majority a proposal seeking consideration on "Bill relating to Remuneration, terms and conditions of service of office-bearers of Constitutional Bodies (First Amendment), 2083'.

The bill was presented by Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Sobita Gautam, on behalf of Prime Minister Balendra Shah.

During discussion on the proposal, lawmakers Rina Upreti, Lima Adhikari Acharya, Krishnahari Budhathoki, Gangalakshmi Awal, Janak Singh Dhami, Kali Bahadur Shah, Madhav Bahadur Thapa, Kamal Subedi, Pramila Kumari Gachhadar, Parashmani Gelal, Parbati BK, Maisa Chaudhary Dagaura, Yashodha Kumari Baral, Sazida Khatun Siddique expressed their views, questions and feedback.

In response to questions raised during the discussion, Minister Gautam said that the government is making arrangements to ensure that the office-bearers of the 13 commissions, most of whom are pensioners, do not receive pensions while drawing salaries for their service to the commission concerned.(RSS)

full_article:
Former Delhi Capitals leg-spinner Sandeep Lamichhane has been appointed Nepal's ODI captain for the upcoming ACC Men's Premier Cup 2026, replacing Rohit Paudel at the helm.

The 26-year-old will return to the leadership role as Nepal prepare for the 10-team tournament in Malaysia, which will be played from August 30 to September 12. Lamichhane previously captained Nepal in 14 ODIs before Paudel took over in 2022.

Lamichhane is Nepal's leading ODI wicket-taker and has been one of the country's most influential cricketers. He became the fastest Nepalese bowler to reach 150 ODI wickets and has also been a key part of the team's recent success in the format.

Paudel, meanwhile, leaves the captaincy after playing an important role in Nepal's rise in international cricket. He has remained a key batter and leader for the side, with his recent performances in the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 also helping Nepal stay in contention for the 2027 ODI World Cup.

full_article:
China's Ambassador to Nepal Zhang Maoming on Monday called on Prime Minister Balendra Shah and discussed issues related to bilateral ties, mutual interests, development partnership and cooperation.

Ambassador Zhang paid a courtesy call on Prime Minister Shah at Singhadurbar, according to the Prime Minister's Office.

"Matters relating to further strengthening Nepal-China relations, promoting cooperation in various fields and advancing development partnership were discussed on the occasion," it said in a statement.

On the occasion, Prime Minister Shah stressed the need to further deepen historical ties with China and work together in areas of common interest, the statement said.

Zhang expressed his best wishes to the Prime Minister and pledged to further strengthen the mutual relations and cooperation between the two countries.

"We exchanged views on our bilateral relations and practical cooperation, and the topics of shared interests in a friendly atmosphere. We agreed to deepen our win-win cooperation, and bring more benefits to the people of Nepal and China," the Chinese diplomat said in a post on X.

Earlier in the day, Prime Minister Shah met Indian Ambassador to Nepal Naveen Srivastava. Shah will also meet with the US Embassy Charge d'Affaires on Tuesday.

Shah had earlier avoided one-on-one engagements and even declined to meet the US Assistant Secretary of State for South and Central Asian Affairs Samir Paul Kapur and President Donald Trump’s special envoy for South and Central Asia Sergio Gor.

Shah broke his self-imposed rule by holding a one-on-one meeting with Asian Development Bank President Masato Kanda, who visited Nepal for three days beginning July 6.

PM Shah had also not undertaken any visit to either the southern or the northern neighbour and instead Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal made back-to-back visits to New Delhi and Beijing in June.

Khanal had earlier said Nepal wants to build stronger and deeper relations with both India and China, describing the southern and northern neighbours as vital partners for the Himalayan nation and recently said Nepal wants to transform itself from a landlocked country into a “vibrant, dynamic bridge” connecting the two neighbours.

नेपालमे चीनक राजदूत झांग माओमिंग सोमदिन प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाहसँ भेंट कए द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्ध, आपसी हित, विकास साझेदारी आ सहयोगसँ जुड़ल विषयमे चर्चा केलथि ।

प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय के अनुसार राजदूत झांग सिंघदुर्बर मे प्रधानमंत्री शाह के शिष्टाचार केलथि।

विज्ञप्तिमे कहल गेल अछि जे, नेपाल-चीन सम्बन्ध आरो मजगूत करब, विभिन्न क्षेत्रमे सहयोग बढाबय आ विकासक साझेदारीकेँ आगू बढेबासँ जुड़ल विषयमे चर्चा कएल गेल अछि ।

बयान मँ कहलौ गेलौ छै कि ई अवसर प प्रधानमंत्री शाह नँ चीन के साथ ऐतिहासिक संबंध क आरू गहरा करै आरू साझा हित के क्षेत्र मँ मिल क काम करै के जरूरत प जोर देलकै ।

झांग न॑ प्रधानमंत्री क॑ अपनऽ शुभकामना व्यक्त करतें हुअ॑ दूनू देशऽ के बीच आपसी संबंध आरू सहयोग क॑ आरू मजबूत करै के प्रतिबद्धता जतैलकै ।

चीनी राजनयिक नँ एक्स पर जारी पोस्ट मँ कहलकै कि हम्में अपनौ द्विपक्षीय संबंध आरू व्यावहारिक सहयोग, आरू साझा हित के विषयौ प दोस्ताना माहौल मँ विचार के आदान-प्रदान करलौ ।

एहि सं पहिने प्रधानमंत्री शाह नेपाल मे भारतीय राजदूत नवीन श्रीवास्तव सं भेंट केलनि। शाह मंगलदिन अमेरिकी दूतावास चार्ज डी अफेयर्स सं सेहो भेंट करताह.

शाह न॑ पहल॑ भी एक-एक करी क॑ सगाई स॑ बचलऽ छेलै आरू दक्षिण आरू मध्य एशियाई मामलऽ के अमेरिकी सहायक विदेश सचिव समीर पॉल कपुर आरू दक्षिण आरू मध्य एशिया लेली राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप केरऽ विशेष दूत सर्जियो गोर स॑ मिलै स॑ भी इनकार करी देल॑ छेलै ।

शाह 6 जुलाई स शुरू भ क तीन दिन लेल नेपाल आयल एशियाई विकास बैंक क अध्यक्ष मसातो कांडा स एक-एक कए बैसार करि अपन स्वंयमय नियम तोड़ि देलथि।

पीएम शाह न॑ भी दक्षिणी या उत्तरी पड़ोसी देशऽ म॑ स॑ कोय भी दौरा नै करलकै आरू एकरऽ बदला म॑ विदेश मंत्री शिसिर खनाल न॑ जून म॑ नई दिल्ली आरू बीजिंग केरऽ पीठ-पीछू दौरा करलकै ।

खनाल न॑ पहल॑ भी कहलकै कि नेपाल भारत आरू चीन दूनू के साथ मजबूत आरू गहरा संबंध बनाबै चाहै छै, दक्षिण आरू उत्तरी पड़ोसी देश क॑ हिमालयी राष्ट्र लेली महत्वपूर्ण भागीदार बतैलकै आरू हाल ही म॑ कहलकै कि नेपाल खुद क॑ भूपरिवेष्टित देश स॑ दू पड़ोसी देश क॑ जोड़ै वाला “जीवंत, गतिशील पुल” म॑ बदलना चाहै छै ।

Sandeep Lamichhane has been appointed the captain of Nepal's One Day International (ODI) team ahead of the upcoming ACC Men's Premier Cup, according to a statement from the International Cricket Council (ICC). The 26-year-old leg-spinner, with 154 wickets in 77 matches, assumes the role from Rohit Paudel.

Lamichhane previously led Nepal in 14 ODIs before Paudel was named captain in 2022. Under Paudel’s leadership, Nepal had a remarkable run, securing victory in 11 out of 12 games in the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2, which earned them a qualification spot in the World Cup Qualifier in Zimbabwe, June 2023. Lamichhane is also notable for reaching 150 ODI wickets faster than any other Nepalese bowler and being the first from Nepal to achieve 100 T20I wickets.

The ACC Men's Premier Cup is scheduled in Malaysia from August 30 to September 12. It will host ten teams, including the top eight from the 2024 ACC Men's Premier Cup and the 2026 ACC Men's Challenger Cup finalists. Team Nepal's lineup includes: Sandeep Lamichhane (c), Aasif Sheikh, Arjun Kumal, Rohit Paudel, Dev Khanal, Dipendra Singh Airee, Sundeep Jora, Basir Ahamad, Ishan Pandey, Gulsan Jha, Sher Malla, Lalit Rajbanshi, Karan KC, Hemant Dhami.

(With inputs from agencies.)

full_article:
Nepal does not have clear information on the whereabouts of the original 1816 Sugauli Treaty that set the Himalayan nation’s boundary with British India, Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told the House of Representatives on Monday. He also said it remains unclear whether Nepal has an official copy of the treaty signed with Britain.

Khanal’s remarks come as the Nepal-India border dispute has sharpened after India and China agreed to reopen the Lipulekh trade route. Nepal claims Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura and Kalapani as its territory, while India says these areas belong to it.

Replying to a query in the House, Khanal said, according to The Kathmandu Post, that Nepal has no definite record on the status of the treaty papers. “The Government of Nepal does not have clear information on whether we possess the official treaty documents. There are records showing that some documents related to certain treaties are kept at the National Archives. But we do not have clear information as to whether those are the actual official treaties,” he said.

He, however, said Nepal does have documents related to the 1816 treaty and the 1950 treaties. The Treaty of Sugauli was signed between Nepal and the East India Company and largely defined Nepal’s territorial boundaries and its relationship with British India.

The 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship, signed between Nepal and India, laid down provisions giving Nepalis and Indians reciprocal rights in several areas in each other’s countries. Under the treaty, India and Nepal share an open border of over 1,751 km, allowing citizens of both countries to travel and work across the border without visas.

In 2016, when the Eminent Persons’ Group on Nepal-India Relations started discussions on reviewing or replacing the 1950 treaty, the Nepali side tried to locate the original document but could not find it, the newspaper reported. The government later gave the Bhekh Bahadur Thapa-led committee a second copy of the 1950 treaty.

A parliamentary inquiry into the missing documents found that the original copies of both the Sugauli Treaty and the Nepal-India treaty could not be located in Nepal. The committee said it had carried out a thorough search at all possible places where historical papers might be kept, including libraries, archives and repositories, as well as the Department of Archaeology, Narayanhiti Palace Museum, Ministry of Law and Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

In 2019, then foreign minister Pradeep Gyawali said his ministry had copies of both treaties but was unsure if they were the originals. “We have both treaties, but we have to forensically verify whether these copies are originals or not,” Gyawali said. “We are also trying to find historical documents and maps in India and the United Kingdom.” On Monday, Khanal also said Nepal would review its treaties and agreements with its national interests at the centre.

In sum, Nepal’s government says it has related records and copies of key treaties, but it still cannot confirm whether the original Sugauli Treaty or the original Nepal-India treaty are in its possession, even as treaty review and border issues remain in focus.
